integrity: The finite cutoff uses exhaustive integer enumeration and exact permutation isomorphism, while the unbounded twin-family statement is proved symbolically. No independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exhaustive lower-order reconstruction check is restricted to bases with at most five named points.
The infinite construction proves a family of collisions, not a classification of all ordered-graph collisions.
Nonalgebraic complete singleton types only; full higher-arity type spaces are not addressed.
Historical priority remains subject to searches under equivalent positional graph-polynomial terminology.
title: Sharp six-parameter girth blindness of ordered triangle-free singleton-type spectra
